permission_evidence.kind: project-owner attestation of direct uploader communication
permission_evidence.summary: The project owner reports that the uploader directly confirmed the dataset is legal to use.

market_scope.raw_scope: mixed United States, Canada, and Puerto Rico
market_scope.approved_scope: 50 United States plus the District of Columbia
market_scope.currency_assumption: The source does not explicitly document currency. AutoValue AI treats sellingprice as USD only after retaining a validated U.S. state or District of Columbia row. This remains an open semantic assumption until the uploader or upstream source confirms it.

target.approved_claim: historical U.S. wholesale auction sale-price estimate for the 2014-2015 source period

required_processing_gates: Verify the exact archive and CSV byte sizes and SHA-256 hashes before parsing.
Retain only records mapped to one of the 50 U.S. states or the District of Columbia; reject Canada and Puerto Rico.
Require a parseable sale date and positive sellingprice target.
Remove VIN and seller from every feature table and published artifact.
Forbid MMR from model features, preprocessing, feature selection, tuning, explanations, and inference payloads because it is a competing valuation estimate and target-leakage risk.
Use a chronological test boundary and keep every normalized VIN in only one split.
Fit imputers, encoders, category grouping, and all learned transforms on training folds only.
Label every result as historical wholesale-auction performance and disclose the 2014-2015 time window.
Do not commit or redistribute raw rows, processed rows, or a downloadable model without a new permission decision.

allowed: aggregate charts that do not expose source rows
hosted predictions from an approved deployment
blocked_pending_review: row-level examples copied from the dataset

notes: The Kaggle page displays an MIT license label, but underlying ownership and upstream provenance have not been independently verified by this project.
The project owner's attestation is the basis for the scoped approval recorded here; it is not a general sublicense or legal conclusion.
This review approves a bounded portfolio use, subject to every processing and publication gate above.
